name: Exhausted
summary: Exhausted: when you do the Establish Supply Line action, you must spend 1 more Supply cube.

mechanics.timing: When the character does Establish Supply Line. Permanent while the sticker is on the character. The sticker does not print when it is gained.
mechanics.effect: Establish Supply Line costs 1 more Supply cube.
restrictions: The extra cost is 1 Supply cube
It applies only to Establish Supply Line
